title: Teach the task-management skill branch-aware WTP usage
description: Update skills/task-management/SKILL.md to explain both short-ID forms, always using the actual ID returned by create, current-branch then legacy automatic selection, foreign-task exclusion, explicit task start for intentional foreign work, detached/non-Git legacy behavior, and why agents must run from the intended branch/worktree. Refresh manual-inspection and external-storage guidance, including the dedicated history-worktree option, while preserving concise imperative workflow guidance, dependency rules, and existing safety constraints. Validate frontmatter and all command examples against the implemented CLI.
